Frame-by-frame

Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Swiggy One Blck's invitation reveal - on a dark premium screen, a black envelope rises into view, its flap opens to show a warm interior, and the membership card slides out revealing the oneBLCK branding.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark charcoal-purple screen: back arrow, centered "oneBLCK" metallic wordmark with a small shield crest and tagline, fine-print membership copy near the bottom, white "Start your journey" button pinned below. Center stage: the envelope.

## Motion spec
Pattern: skeuomorphic envelope reveal, ~2.5s.
- The envelope (matte black, subtle sheen) slides up from below into center (500ms, ease-out) and settles with a soft shadow.
- The flap rotates open on its top edge (rotateX 0 -> 160deg, 600ms, ease-in-out) revealing a warm peach-orange interior.
- The card slides up out of the envelope (translateY, 500ms, ease-out, 100ms after the flap passes 90deg), tilting a few degrees as it clears, the oneBLCK mark catching a light sweep (gradient highlight passing left to right, 400ms).
- The card parks half-emerged, floating slightly above the envelope mouth.

## Calibration
- Flap rotation needs real perspective (rotateX with transform-origin at the flap hinge); a scaleY fake reads instantly.
- The light sweep on the card is the premium cue - keep it slow and single-pass.

## Reduced motion
Envelope crossfades to the open state with the card already revealed (400ms).

## Don't miss
- The envelope interior is the only warm color on screen; keep it saturated so the open moment lands.
- Wordmark, copy, and button never animate - the envelope owns the stage.
